source: Toh Toh United LeaderBoard.docx (FRS v1.1, 10 Sept 2026)

rows.expectation: I will be able to get Score/XP for every Level 3 match I play and see my position on the Leaderboard.
rows.cos:
Leaderboard is only for ATOM Store App Prepaid users.

Player will be eligible for the leaderboard ranking from game Level 3. Only Level 3 match outcome will be counted.

Score/XP for each Level 3 match:
1. Win = 3
2. Draw = 1
3. Loss = 0

Ranking will be based on 3 parameters:
1. Accumulated Score/XP (1st parameter). Higher Score/XP will get the higher rank.
2. Total Goals Count (1st tiebreaker). If Score/XP is same, the player with more total goals across all matches will get the higher rank.
3. Completion Timestamp (2nd tiebreaker). If Score/XP and goals both are same, the player who completed the last Level 3 match earlier will get the higher rank.
rows.ac:
After every Level 3 match, the Score/XP of the match outcome and the goals of the match will be added to the player's leaderboard record, along with the match completion time.

Example:
Player A and Player B both have 10 Score/XP and 19 Goals. Player A finished the last Level 3 match at 11:20 AM and Player B at 3:50 PM on the same day. So Player A will be Rank 1 and Player B will be Rank 2.

Postpaid users and players below Level 3 will not be ranked.
rows.note:
- Total goals means only the goals scored by the player, or also the goals of the opponent? Only from Level 3 matches?
>> TBC

- Will Score/XP, goals and rank reset to zero when a new season starts?
>> TBC

>> TBC

rows.feature: Level 3 Match Result and Redirect to Leaderboard
rows.expectation: I will be able to see my match result and instant prize after finishing Level 3, and go to the Leaderboard from the popup.
rows.cos:
After finishing Level 3, user will see the Mystery Box popup along with the match result (Win, Draw or Loss).

Then user will get the Instant Prize popup.

By clicking on the button from the popup, user will be redirected to the Leaderboard landing page.

There will also be a button or icon on the game level page to redirect the user to the Leaderboard.
rows.ac:
User will see the Mystery Box popup with the match result for Win, Draw and Loss.

User will see the Instant Prize popup after the Mystery Box popup.

By clicking the button on the popup, user will land on the Leaderboard page, and the rank will include the match just played.

From the game level page, user can open the Leaderboard by clicking the Leaderboard button/icon.

rows.expectation: I will be able to see the top players, my own rank and the remaining time of the season on the Leaderboard page.
rows.cos:
Leaderboard title (e.g. Top 100, Top 500 or Top 1000) and the Season number (1, 2, 3 etc.) will be shown as configured in BackOffice.

There will be a banner at the top to show the monthly lucky draw program info. The banner will be clickable and redirect to the specific page (App or Web) for more info, e.g. lucky draw or winner info.

Countdown timer will be shown to push the players to play more. The timer will be reset when the next season (lucky draw program) starts.

There will be a leaderboard table with 4 columns:
1. Rank No#
2. Player Name (as given by the user)
3. Score/XP (based on accumulated match outcome)
4. Total Goals (accumulated scored goals)

If the user is not in the top 10, the user's own rank will be pinned at the bottom with a sticky 'Continue Challenge' button.
rows.ac:
User will see the title, season number, banner, countdown timer and the leaderboard table on the page.

Players will be sorted by the ranking logic in row 1.0.

If the banner has a redirect link, clicking it will open that App or Web page. If there is no link, nothing will happen.

If the user is outside the top 10, the user's rank will be shown at the bottom in a sticky bar. If the user is in the top 10, no sticky bar will be shown.

By clicking 'Continue Challenge', user will be redirected to the game level page.

rows.expectation: I will be able to see the winners of the recent 3 seasons.
rows.cos:
There will be a 'Previous Winners >' link on the Leaderboard page, next to the leaderboard table.

By clicking the link, user will be redirected to the Previous Winners page.

In the Previous Winners page, there will be season tabs for the recent 3 finished seasons (e.g. Season 3, Season 2, Season 1). The latest season will be selected by default.

Under the tabs, there will be an info text about the winners or the season.

For each season, winners from position 1 to 10 will be shown with:
1. Position No#
2. Player Name
3. Masked mobile number (e.g. 09xxxxxxx96)
4. Township / City / Country
5. Prize image
rows.ac:
User will see the 'Previous Winners >' link on the Leaderboard page.

By clicking the link, user will see the Previous Winners page with the latest season tab selected.

By clicking another season tab, user will see the winners of that season.

By clicking Back, user will be redirected to the Leaderboard page.
rows.note:
Not in FRS v1.1. Kept from the earlier story; to be confirmed with BA.

rows.expectation: I will be informed with a popup when the Leaderboard campaign is stopped or something unexpected happens.
rows.cos:
When the campaign is stopped, user will see a popup. The popup message will be configured from BackOffice.

User will also see a popup in case something unexpected happens.

There will be disable and enable function for the whole Leaderboard feature in BackOffice.

When the Leaderboard feature is disabled from BackOffice, user will not be able to access the Leaderboard.

rows.expectation: I will be able to configure the Leaderboard campaign from BackOffice.
rows.cos:
BackOffice user will be able to configure:
1. Leaderboard banner with redirect link (App or Web page). The redirect link is optional, not mandatory.
2. Campaign schedule for the countdown timer.
3. Season number (1, 2, 3 etc.).
4. Leaderboard title (e.g. Top 100, Top 500 or Top 1000).
5. Terms and Conditions in English, Myanmar and Chinese.
6. Campaign stopped popup message.
7. Enable / Disable of the whole Leaderboard feature.
rows.ac:
After saving in BackOffice, the changes will reflect in the app.

Banner can be saved without a redirect link.

When the next season starts, the countdown timer will be reset as per the new schedule.
